query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `dj_leads` (
  `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `name` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` VARCHAR(320),
  `soundcloudUrl` TEXT,
  `beatportUrl` TEXT,
  `instagramUrl` TEXT,
  `spotifyUrl` TEXT,
  `followers` INT DEFAULT 0,
  `totalTracks` INT DEFAULT 0,
  `avgPlays` INT DEFAULT 0,
  `primaryGenre` VARCHAR(100),
  `subgenres` TEXT,
  `country` VARCHAR(100),
  `city` VARCHAR(100),
  `status` ENUM('new', 'contacted', 'responded', 'registered', 'uploaded', 'rejected') DEFAULT 'new' NOT NULL,
  `source` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `priority` ENUM('low', 'medium', 'high', 'urgent') DEFAULT 'medium' NOT NULL,
  `lastContactedAt` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  `contactCount` INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `notes` TEXT,
  `invitationCode` VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE,
  `invitationSentAt` TIMESTAMP NULL,
  `discoveredAt` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `dj_leads_status_idx` (`status`),
  INDEX `dj_leads_source_idx` (`source`),
  INDEX `dj_leads_priority_idx` (`priority`),
  INDEX `dj_leads_email_idx` (`email`)
);
